# gyro_mail_alias (Resource)

A forwarding address (alias) on a corporate mail service.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gyro_mail_alias" "sales" {
  service_id = 123
  local_part = "sales"
  goto       = ["alice@example.com", "bob@example.com"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `goto` (List of String) Destination addresses.
- `local_part` (String)
- `service_id` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `address` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
